thread:
Maria Gomez: Ok team — Q2 roadmap sync: need to lock down SOC2 readiness scope and the related infra work (audit logs, KMS/HSM support, retention policy). Can we list must-haves vs nice-to-haves and owners?
Alex Patel: +1. We should treat SOC2 as a cross-org project. Must-haves: documented controls, immutable audit logs, key management integration, and retention policies.
Cheng Li: For audit logs — I propose a two-phase rollout: Phase 1 = append-only, centralized logs with 1:1 request->trace mapping. Phase 2 = schema-backed event store + retention UI.
Samir Rao: KMS/HSM: P0 for Private + Dedicated customers (they ask). Hosted can get BYOK via AWS KMS for now. POC with Vault+HSM looks doable.
Kate Johnson: Product needs: per-customer retention override, legal holds, and exportable audit bundles for audits. Also UX for key management: show active keys, rotation dates, last rotated by.
Maria Gomez: Good. Let's define launch criteria for SOC2 readiness (internal OKR alignment):
- Evidence: control docs + system diagrams + runbooks
- Audit logs: store >= 1 year by default (configurable), tamper-evident (append-only WAL + checksum)
- KMS: integration tested end-to-end (encrypt/decrypt + rotation) for Dedicated/Private; hosted BYOK with KMS CMKs supported
- Retention: defaults + customer overrides implemented in UI and API
- E2E test coverage for access/control policies and key rotation workflows
Alex Patel: Tech notes: we should use HMAC per-log entry and write to S3 with object lock enabled for append-only. Example retention config for logs:
```
audit_logs:
  default_retention_days: 365
  min_retention_days: 90
  allow_customer_override: true
```
Cheng Li: For tamper evidence, append HMAC+sequence and mirror writes to remote archival storage. We'll add a small lambda that verifies checksums nightly.
Samir Rao: KMS POC plan:
- Week 1: Vault + CloudHSM POC (encrypt/decrypt + rotation)
- Week 2: integrate with runtime to store DEK encrypted with CMK
- Week 3: test rotation and key compromise scenarios + document recovery steps
security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 control mapping doc updated at /docs/security/soc2_mapping_v0.9 (link) — please add evidence links by EOD Friday.
Kate Johnson: OKRs proposal (security & compliance area):
- OKR 1: Achieve SOC2 Type II readiness for hosted + Dedicated pilots by end of Q2. Key result: 90% control coverage documented + 30 days of audit evidence collected.
- OKR 2: Implement audit logging baseline and retention UI. Key result: Audit logs ingest with 99.9% fidelity and retention controls in UI for targeted customers.
- OKR 3: KMS/HSM support for Private/Dedicated. Key result: Vault+HSM POC completed and 2 enterprise customers onboarded.
Maria Gomez: Prioritization notes: must ship SOC2 artifacts and audit logs first. KMS/HSM is high but can be gated to Dedicated/Private. Retention UI is medium priority (Phase 1 API support then UI).
Alex Patel: Risks: storage costs for 1yr+ logs, perf impact of HMACs on write path, key rotation complexity across shards. Need budget estimate asap.
Cheng Li: Action items: Cheng -> audit log schema + nightly verifier POC (due 2024-06-10). Samir -> KMS/HSM POC + doc (due 2024-06-17). Kate -> retention UX PRD + API spec (due 2024-06-03). Maria -> SOC2 control matrix + auditor shortlist (due 2024-06-05). Alex -> cost estimate & infra design (due 2024-06-07).
Samir Rao: Also recommend a small internal alpha with Platform team to exercise rotation/failover.
Maria Gomez: Sounds good. I'll consolidate into the roadmap doc and create the OKR ticket set. Meeting end: will follow up with calendar invite for weekly sync. :thumbsup:
Alex Patel: ack.
Cheng Li: ack.
Samir Rao: ack.
security-bot: New task created: #security-roadmap-soc2 (tracking)
Kate Johnson: I'll start drafting the PRD and loop in legal for retention requirements.
Maria Gomez: Thanks everyone — post any blockers in this thread and I'll escalate to PM leadership if needed.
